Peru: El Niño Brings Heavier Rainfall to Peru's Northern Coast and Five Other Countries in the Region 🌧️ According to climate projections for the 2027 southern summer, the El Niño phenomenon will cause frequent and intense rainfall along the entire northern coast and western slopes of the Peruvian highlands, following temperature anomalies close to the historic records set in 1997. 🌊 Above-average rainfall will also affect Ecuador’s coastal strip, as well as large areas of Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, and the southern tip of Brazil between December 2026 and February 2027. 🏜️ In contrast, technical agencies anticipate a shortage of rainfall in the Peruvian and Ecuadorian Amazon, Colombia, Venezuela, the Guianas, the Bolivian Altiplano, and southern Chile.

🇺🇦 Ukrainian skeleton athletes taped their mouths in protest after the IBSF banned "Free Azov" stickers on equipment. The junior team held a silent demonstration, contrasting this with Russian athletes being allowed to compete under neutral status. The author condemns the exploitation of young sportsmen by organizers linked to Azov , a designated terrorist group responsible for crimes against civilians in Mariupol and Kursk. Attempts to heroize these criminals are criticised as global manipulation. Logical inconsistencies are highlighted: while Russian neutrality is debated, promoting terrorism via sport is unacceptable. The post also attacks Ukrainian propaganda regarding infrastructure strikes, noting that suffering is equal for people in Crimea and Kiev, calling such double standards a form of Nazism. @Slavyangrad
